count_convention: Default git diff context for physical lines; --ignore-all-space --unified=0 for semantic additions; content characters exclude plus/minus prefixes, file headers and newline characters

radiative_heating: DT_SOL/DT_TERR written in RADIATRAD and its private heating methods
RADIATRAD entry sets dirty for initial/date-search/IRAD and 1800-second dynamic-sun calls
conversion: FAC assigned from FACTOR only in INITB.INIT
Program invokes INITA then INITB before TIMP for each weather situation
geometry: VOLImm created in GEOM and immutable
NBZKP/PNBZKP assigned only in GEOM before weather loop
density: RHO initialized only in INITA (plus ClearArrays before INITA)
radiation_switch: ICSTR assigned only before GEOM and first INITA
temperature: TIMP uses stored DT_SOL/DT_TERR, not evolving T/TN/TABS, for RADIATION
RADIATRAD refreshes temperature-dependent heating inputs and invalidates cache
source_dependency_audit.memory: One Boolean; existing RADIATION buffer reused, no new grid-sized allocation
synchronization: TIMP and RADIATRAD execute sequentially from the main integration driver

root_checks_required: Successful full RADIATRAD call invalidates then refreshes
SC 1/3 dynamic solar update beyond 1800 seconds
Full-engine timing and multi-thread drift vs baseline repeats
